payload.title: Imported translations say who wrote them, not that AI did: page notice, Markdown twin, JSON-LD
payload.description:
Gap left by PPY-b64b0b (PR #1654): an imported translation (metadata.localization.translation = imported, provenance naming the human author) still shows the reader's-language line 'translated by AI' under the byline, and its Markdown twin says 'Translation: machine'. False for human-written copy.

Fix: the page notice (components.translation_notice), the Markdown twin facts line, JSON-LD (translationOfWork stays; add author/translator for imported copy) and every renderer of the notice read the version's translation kind. For imported: say in the page's own language that the copy was written by the named author (from provenance) and link to the original; never claim AI. Machine behaviour unchanged. New interface strings translation.importedLabel (with {author} and {original}) required in every public language: es-419, zh-Hans, en. Specs: Gherkin for both kinds. Docs: multilingual-serving, story-translation-procedure.
